title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Supporting and Guaranteeing the Comprehensive Deepening of Reform and Opening Up of the Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Supporting and Ensuring the Comprehensive Deepening of Reform and Opening up of the Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone

Fa Fa [2022] No. 3

In order to thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, comprehensively implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the celebration of the 40th anniversary of the establishment of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, conscientiously implement the "Plan for Comprehensively Deepening the Reform and Opening up of the Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone" issued by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council, give full play to the judicial service and guarantee functions, further promote the comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up of the Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Modern Service Industry Cooperation Zone (hereinafter referred to as the Qianhai Cooperation Zone), build a demonstration zone for the rule of law under socialism with Chinese characteristics, and in light of the actual work of the people's courts, the following opinions are formulated.

I. Overall Requirements

1. Guiding Ideology. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, comprehensively implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the plenary sessions of the 19th Central Committee, deeply implement Xi Jinping's Thought on the Rule of Law, adhere to relying on Hong Kong, serving the mainland, and facing the world, in accordance with the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, focus on the strategic positioning of the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, promote the dual drive of reform and the rule of law, and serve to deepen the closer cooperation between Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Seize the important opportunities of the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, support the Qianhai Cooperation Zone in taking the lead in trials and actively exploring in building a demonstration zone for the construction of the rule of law under socialism with Chinese characteristics. Support Hong Kong and Macao in integrating into the overall national development, join hands with the Qianhai Cooperation Zone to jointly build a world-class bay area and a world-class city cluster, and strive to build the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area into an innovative experimental platform for comprehensively deepening reform and a high-level gateway hub for opening up to the outside world.

2. Main Objectives. Promote the connection of legal rules and mechanisms with Hong Kong and Macao, make full use of the successful experiences and resources of Hong Kong and Macao in the construction of the rule of law, and enhance the level of rule of law exchange and cooperation between Shenzhen and Hong Kong. Support the high-standard construction of the Shenzhen-Hong Kong International Legal Services Zone in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, take the lead in carrying out pilot projects and creating innovative models, help it become a pilot and demonstration zone with a highly law-based business environment, and enhance its pivotal position in the construction of the "Double Zones" (Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and Pilot Demonstration Zone of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics). Solidly promote institutional reform and innovation, promote the innovative development of the modern service industry, enhance the level of opening up of legal affairs to the outside world, and strengthen the demonstration function of adjudication work in the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Lay a solid legal foundation for the Qianhai Cooperation Zone to initially form a globally competitive business environment by 2025 and to achieve a world-class business environment by 2035.

II. Enhance the Level of Opening Up of Legal Affairs to the Outside World

3. Improve the International Commercial Trial Organization System in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone. Support the further improvement and perfection of the international commercial trial organization system in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, construct a fair, efficient, convenient, and low-cost system and mechanism for handling international commercial disputes, and create a preferred venue for commercial trials in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.

4. Expand the Scope of Accepting Foreign-Related Civil and Commercial Cases in Accordance with the Law. In light of the expansion of the development space of the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, scientifically adjust the jurisdictional rules of relevant people's courts for foreign-related civil and commercial disputes, support the Qianhai Cooperation Zone People's Court (hereinafter referred to as the Qianhai Court) in expanding its jurisdiction over foreign-related civil and commercial cases in an orderly manner in accordance with the law, and support the pilot acceptance of foreign-related civil and commercial cases without connection points but where the parties have agreed to jurisdiction, in accordance with the law.

5. Simplify Litigation Procedures for Cases Involving Hong Kong and Macao. In accordance with the principles of mutual respect, seeking common ground while reserving differences, and convenience and legality, support the Qianhai Court in simplifying the judicial confirmation of litigation subject qualifications, authorization for service of process, service procedures, and examination and determination of litigation evidence in cases involving Hong Kong and Macao. Apply summary procedures and single-judge trials in accordance with the law to improve the efficiency of litigation in civil and commercial disputes involving Hong Kong and Macao. Strengthen the construction of an interregional judicial assistance system with Chinese characteristics, explore the establishment of an electronic platform for civil and commercial judicial assistance in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and in civil and commercial cases involving Hong Kong and Macao, explore, with the consent of the parties, the use of parties, lawyers, notarial institutions, etc., to assist in forwarding documents to improve the efficiency of service of process.

6. Promote the Construction of a Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Judicial Research Platform. Develop new-type think tanks for judicial research with Chinese characteristics, support the establishment of a Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao judicial research platform, and focus on personnel exchanges, issue research, and seminars and training to promote research on legal issues such as the connection of legal systems between the mainland, Hong Kong, and Macao under the framework of "one country, two systems, three legal jurisdictions," the docking of working mechanisms, and the comparison of international commercial rules.

III. Promote the Connection of Rules and the Docking of Mechanisms

7. Improve the Mechanism for Ascertaining and Applying Foreign Law. Establish and improve the mechanism for ascertaining and applying foreign law in the trial of cases by people's courts, explore the construction of a unified platform for ascertaining foreign law, support Hong Kong and Macao legal experts in appearing before the Qianhai Court to provide assistance in ascertaining foreign law, and expand channels and methods for ascertaining foreign law. Support the Qianhai Court in applying for authorization to pilot the exploration of a mechanism for applying foreign law, and on the premise of not violating the basic principles of Chinese law or harming national sovereignty, security, and public interests, allow Hong Kong-invested, Macao-invested, Taiwan-invested, and foreign-invested enterprises registered in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone to agree by agreement to apply foreign law to resolve contract disputes, or to apply international treaties, international customs, and international commercial rules to resolve disputes.

8. Build an International Commercial Dispute Resolution Center. Support the Qianhai Cooperation Zone in taking the lead in establishing an international commercial dispute resolution center where litigation, mediation, and arbitration are both independent and coordinated. Promote the docking of work between the Qianhai Court and well-known international commercial arbitration institutions and international commercial mediation organizations, and improve the "one-stop" diversified dispute resolution mechanism for international commercial disputes. Further improve the mechanism for linking litigation and mediation between the Qianhai Court and Hong Kong and Macao mediation institutions, admit qualified Hong Kong and Macao mediation institutions to participate in mediation in areas such as international commerce and intellectual property, support Hong Kong and Macao mediators and lawyers in participating in mediation, and explore the pilot acceptance by the Qianhai Court of judicial confirmation cases for this type of mediation agreement. Explore the establishment of a unified qualification recognition system for Hong Kong and Macao mediators practicing in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and construct a system for evaluating the professional standards of mediation.

9. Build a Mechanism for Hong Kong and Macao Legal Services to Participate in Litigation. Promote the implementation of a licensing mechanism for qualified Hong Kong and Macao lawyers to represent clients in civil and commercial cases involving Hong Kong and Macao in the Qianhai Court, and gradually provide convenience for qualified Hong Kong and Macao lawyers to act as litigation representatives in other areas of Shenzhen.

IV. Promote Judicial Exchanges and Assistance between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao

10. Intensify Judicial Exchanges with the Hong Kong and Macao Regions. Promote the simplification of approval procedures for cross-border judicial exchanges and cooperation, support the Qianhai Cooperation Zone in carrying out exchange activities such as legal seminars, judicial forums, and moot courts with Hong Kong and Macao, and promote the normalization and institutionalization of professional judicial exchanges.

11. Expand Channels for Judicial Talent Exchange between Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and Macao. Adhere to the "high-end, precise, and cutting-edge" orientation, strengthen the training and reserve of high-level rule of law talents, refine the systems for legal research scholars and legal interns, increase joint training efforts for rule of law talents, and form a echelon of foreign-related legal professionals with an international perspective, a thorough understanding of international legal rules, and familiarity with foreign laws.

V. Comprehensively Deepen Reform and Innovation

12. Support the Creation of a World-Class Business Environment. Improve the judicial protection mechanism for the rights and interests of investors such as foreign-invested and private enterprises in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, adhere to equal litigation status, equal application of law, and equal legal liability for all types of market entities, protect the legitimate rights and interests of enterprises and individuals engaged in cross-border commercial investments in accordance with the law, and support and guide the development of the modern service industry with a first-class market-oriented, law-based, and internationalized business environment.

13. Support the Construction of a Maritime Center City. Serve and guarantee the implementation of the national maritime strategy, support the construction of the Shenzhen Tribunal of the Guangzhou Maritime Court, properly adjudicate maritime cases, and enhance the international influence of maritime adjudication work. Strengthen the work connection with legal service institutions such as maritime legal consultation and maritime arbitration in the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, support the construction of the Maritime Arbitration Center of the Shenzhen International Arbitration Court, and build a diversified international maritime legal service center.

14. Strengthen Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights. Support the construction of the Shenzhen Intellectual Property Tribunal and the reform and innovation of intellectual property adjudication, explore new legal protection models for digital intellectual property rights and interests of new types such as artificial intelligence, internet information, and life information. Improve the rules for the protection of core technology intellectual property rights in key areas. Improve judicial adjudication rules and increase the intensity of sanctions against monopoly and unfair competition behaviors in the network environment. Continuously implement the strictest intellectual property protection system, strictly implement the punitive damages system for intellectual property infringement. Cooperate with institutions such as the China (Shenzhen) Intellectual Property Protection Center, the National Copyright Innovation and Development Base, and the Shenzhen Branch of the National Overseas Intellectual Property Dispute Response Guidance Center, strengthen the construction of an "one-stop" collaborative protection platform for intellectual property, promote the improvement of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism and a rapid rights protection mechanism for intellectual property, and improve the cross-border cooperation mechanism for intellectual property cases.

15. Improve the Litigation Service Level of Smart Courts. Support the Qianhai Court in strengthening the construction of smart courts, with the goal of "one-stop online service" and "one-time completion," improve the construction of an international, standardized, and intelligent litigation service platform, focus on building a new mechanism for full-process online litigation and a new model for litigation services, strengthen the docking of litigation services with Hong Kong and Macao, and provide convenient, efficient, and low-cost dispute resolution services for domestic and foreign parties.

VI. Strengthen Organizational Guarantees

16. Strengthen Organizational Leadership. It is necessary to thoroughly implement the general requirements of the Party's construction in the new era, thoroughly implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the plenary sessions of the 19th Central Committee, and conscientiously implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China. Taking the opportunity of supporting and ensuring the comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up of the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, further deepen the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system of the people's courts, adhere to a systematic concept, strengthen overall coordination, ensure that all reforms are based on law and coordinated, and ensure that all measures are pragmatic, effective, scientific, and effective.

17. Improve the Working Mechanism. All relevant units of the Supreme People's Court should strengthen guidance on their respective lines, and the First Circuit Court and the First International Commercial Court should enhance the initiative and foresight in serving the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, make full use of the convenience of being stationed in Shenzhen, based on judicial functions, actively serve the major strategy of comprehensively deepening reform of the Qianhai Cooperation Zone, and continuously promote the reform process. The Guangdong Provincial High People's Court and the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court should consolidate their main responsibilities, strengthen supervision and implementation, actively seek support from relevant departments, pool the joint force of service and guarantee, and accelerate the implementation of various construction and reform tasks.

January 17, 2022
